purpose: Teach: 言いよう/腐っ/しつこく/概ね/受けとめ/取り消し/ふたたび/大嫌い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの言いよう、優しいよね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather's way of speaking is really gentle, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft, observant opening. Warm noticing in a quiet voice. Slight smile underneath — she's watching him notice something good. Gentle pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、腐った果物食べちゃダメだよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm not supposed to eat rotten fruit, right?
lines.style: Small, serious question. Checking his logic with someone he trusts. Slight pause before the question mark — genuinely uncertain, not seeking approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達がしつこく誘ってくるのね
lines.en: Sho, your friend keeps asking you to do things, doesn't he.
lines.style: Gentle reflection. Not a question despite the rhythm — she's naming something she's noticed. Warm but thoughtful, like she's giving him room to think.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、宿題、概ね終わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I mostly finished my homework already.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Straightforward, not bragging. A small lift on 「終わった」— he did something and he's letting her know. Genuine satisfaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのご注意を、ちゃんと受けとめてね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you really listen to what your dad is telling you.
lines.style: Tender firmness. Not scolding — guidance from someone who cares. Slightly more weight on 「ちゃんと」. Clear but not cold. The voice of someone who knows he can understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんに、お約束の取り消しを言わなきゃ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have to tell Mom I'm cancelling the promise I made.
lines.style: Small, wry realisation in his voice. Not happy about it but honest. Slight grimace in the tone — he knows what he has to do. Matter-of-fact, like he's telling himself too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、ふたたびお店遊びに連れて行ってあげる
lines.en: Sho, Mei-sis is going to take you to the store again.
lines.style: Warm promise. Soft opening. The 「ふたたび」carries affection — she's rewarding him, but gently. No fanfare. Just her saying: I'm doing this for you.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、人参が大嫌いだよ
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact complaint. A tiny bit wry — he's telling her something she probably already knows. No whine, just truth. Comfortable closeness in his tone.
